name: Lantern Night: Local Customs (d6)
description:
Every town keeps it its own way: roll a d6 or pick a custom for each town. Customs are flavour, not rules.

Rulebook, Chapter 8: Lantern Night.

results.description: A costume parade through the square at midnight.
A masked ball at the mayor’s house.
A bonfire in the square, and a straw monster burned at dawn.
Bells rung every hour to keep the real monsters away. They never work.
